name: National Fellowship for OBC Students (NF-OBC)
provider: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India (UGC nodal agency; NBCFDC portal)

rules.quote: An OBC student admitted to M.Phil./Ph.D. course in a University or academic institution after completing the required formalities of admission, is eligible for the award of Fellowship
Only those, doing regular and full time M.Phil./Ph.D. course of a University/Research Institution shall be eligible for the fellowship.
The scheme covers all universities/institutions recognized by the University Grants Commission (UGC).

rules.value: 300 JRF per year; total JRF+SRF period max 5 years
rules.quote: The total period of award of JRF and SRF shall not exceed a period of 5 years.

rules.value: UGC notifies through advertisement; eligibility subject to the advertisement
rules.quote: The UGC is the nodal agency for implementing the scheme and notifies the scheme through advertisements in the media at a suitable date.

amount.text: JRF Rs 25,000 per month; SRF Rs 28,000 per month (page rates; current UGC rates may be higher)
amount.quote: The rate of fellowship for JRF level is Rs. 25000 per month and for SRF level, it is Rs. 28000 per month.

deadline.text: Not stated; announced through UGC/NBCFDC advertisement
